title: GoalDTO
description: Stable read-surface wire shape mesh emits to console-ui for a single goal. DISTINCT from mesh's internal GoalRow DB-row struct (whose json tags are Postgres column names). Per the genericity ledger: the base DTO keeps flywheel aggregates (proposals / workflow_attention) OUT — those live in GoalDTODetail as optional detail only. additionalProperties:false makes a smuggled field a structural validation failure. The TypeScript interface in src/read-surface-goal.ts is the paired source of truth.

goal_id.description: Stable goal identifier (e.g. G04). Contract-owned key.

status.description: Authority-resolved lifecycle status. OPEN string; do not enumerate.

progress_pct.description: Canonical completion percentage in [0,100]. Normalized at toDTO().

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the goal row was last updated.
